/itineraryStops/3/visitBasics/walking.source_en: Easy — flat, soft sand and level pine-forest paths; a short signed footpath connects the beach up to ⟦G0⟧

/itineraryStops/3/visitBasics/admission.source_en: FREE — no admission fee for the beach

/itineraryStops/4/name.source_en: Return to Seoul (⟦G0⟧ Station or Hongik University Station)

/itineraryStops/4/timeUsed/1.source_en: Drive to Seoul via the Seoul-Yangyang Expressway and Inje-Yangyang Tunnel (~2.5 hours depending on traffic)

/itineraryStops/4/timeUsed/3.source_en: Drop-off at Hongik University Station Exit 8 (~19:15)

/itineraryStops/4/whyOnRoute.source_en: The return runs in reverse-pickup order: **⟦G0⟧ drop-off first** (~18:45), then **Hongik University Station** (~19:15). The 12-hour tour length is calibrated around this timing — guests with evening dinner reservations should book for 20:00 or later to allow a safety buffer for traffic. Friday and Sunday evenings run heavier on the expressway, but this tour departs only Mondays and Thursdays, so traffic on the return leg is usually moderate; still, notify the driver-guide if you have a flight or hard appointment.

/itineraryStops/4/description.source_en:
After ⟦G0⟧, the coach takes the **Seoul-Yangyang Expressway** westbound back into Seoul, passing again through the Inje-Yangyang Tunnel. Drop-offs are sequenced in reverse-pickup order: **⟦G1⟧ Station Exit 2 first at approximately 18:45**, then **Hongik University Station Exit 8 at approximately 19:15**. 

Both drop-off points are at the same locations as the morning pickup. Guests connecting to evening plans in Hongdae or ⟦G1⟧ should allow a comfortable buffer for traffic. Exact arrival times depend on East Sea coast and Seoul traffic on the day.
